summary: This is a routine 424B5 prospectus supplement filed by The Charles Schwab Corporation for a public offering of $2.6 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes: $1.25 billion of 5.108% fixed-to-floating notes due 2032 and $1.35 billion of 5.655% fixed-to-floating notes due 2037. The notes are unsecured, not exchange-listed, and will be sold via underwriters led by BofA Securities, Citigroup, Morgan Stanley, TD Securities, and Wells Fargo. Proceeds to Schwab before expenses are $2.58955 billion. No special-situation attributes apply; the filing is an ordinary debt issuance.
